title: Other Mommy
description: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

title: André Leon Talley: Style is Forever
description: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.

title: 28 Days Later
description: A group of misguided animal rights activists free a caged chimp infected with the “Rage” virus from a medical research lab. When London bike courier Jim (Cillian Murphy) wakes up from a coma a month after, he finds his city all but deserted. On the run from the zombie-like victims of the Rage, Jim stumbles upon a group of survivors, including Selena (Naomie Harris) and cab driver Frank (Brendan Gleeson), and joins them on a perilous journey to what he hopes will be safety.

title: LA's Rich and Successful Film Festival Shorts Program
description: RSFF5 is co-presented by Topcat Management, Sogbots, and the American Cinematheque.

title: DEAD SOULS
description: For his directorial swan song, Alex Cox (REPO MAN, STRAIGHT TO HELL) stars in this frontier fable of American greed, playing the mysterious drifter Strindler as he scours the West for the names of dead Mexican laborers. In this loose adaptation of Nikolai Gogol’s 1842 novel Dead Souls , Strindler – or is it Swindler? – raises eyebrows when he offers to pay a pretty penny to add to his list of names. Wandering affably from saloon to ranch, Strindler exercises the old adage that money talks – but sometimes too loudly. Pistol duels and crooked officials abound, and Spaghetti Western legend Gianni Garko (IF YOU MEET SARTANA PRAY FOR YOUR DEATH) claims a co-writer credit. But Cox’s idiosyncrasy stands out as the film veers tonally through the picaresque, dark satire and other unexpected twists. DEAD SOULS is a meditative Western that takes place at the borderlands of the American nightmare: where fortunes rest on a dirty deal, and legacies are built on blood and gold.

title: VACANCES
description: FILMMAKER IN PERSON! A strange and unusual mixture of warts-and-all family portraiture, subtle exposé of class and privilege, and minimalist depiction of a particular setting that’s rendered with an almost miraculously tactile sense of presence, photographer and filmmaker Victoria Hely-Hutchinson’s VACANCES is a deceptively unassuming film. Filmed over the course of a decade at the property in Provence inhabited by Hely-Hutchinson’s outrageously uninhibited grandmother, a bohemian Austro-Hungarian countess and family matriarch, VACANCES grew out of Hely-Hutchinson’s 2016 short film of the same name, and is something of a filmic complement to her autobiographical 2023 book, “I Left My Grandmother’s House”. The documentary delves, with a grace and open-endedness that belies its analytical bite, into both the bigger-than-life personality of “granny” as well as the sometimes strained dynamics among the rest of the family, including Hely-Hutchinson’s grandfather, mother, and siblings. Unique in suggesting by turns cinema vérité, reality TV, chamber theater, and the minimalism of landscape cinema, VACANCES is a profoundly singular work – a film whose technique is nearly invisible, but which sneaks up on you with its trenchant perceptions, layered meanings, and emotional and filmic complexity. “This time-lapse film, shot over a period of ten years, follows members of several generations of a wealthy aristocratic family with Austro-Hungarian roots. The entire film is set in a Provençal villa, whose social heart is the swimming pool, around which the women gather to exchange various observations and, surreptitiously, gossip. The center of the family is the aging matriarch, who likes to talk about her extravagant, promiscuous life, but at the same time commands all the attention and authority of those around her. However, her influence gradually weakens with each passing generation.” –JI.HLAVA INTERNATIONAL DOCUMENTARY FILM FESTIVAL

title: HOPE
description: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok (Hwang Jung- min) and officer Sung-ae (Hoyeon) are called to find a mysterious creature that has wreaked havoc on the village. In the nearby forest, a coterie of hunters, including Sung- ki (Zo In-Sung) set out to track the bea...

title: An Autumn's Tale
description: Newly arrived in New York City from Hong Kong and unhappily reunited with boyfriend Danny Chan, Jennifer (Cherie Chung) finds a guide to this strange new world in the person of distant relation Samuel Pang, aka “Sampan” (Chow Yun-fat, at his most goofily charming)… and the prospect, possibly, of something more. A time capsule of ’80s NYC—particularly Chinatown—and a perfectly delightful blend of odd-couple romance and amiable comedy from Cheung and longtime collaborator Alex Law, who took home Best Screenplay honors at the 7th Hong Kong Film Awards for his work here. (Lowell Lo’s heartstring-tugging score was, alas, robbed.) Part of The Leaves Are Falling

title: Bird in Hand
description: Writer/Director Melody C. Roscher in person after the Friday, October 9th screening!

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother 35mm
description: Latif is a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith, and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston in search of breast milk for his infant daughter, all while dodging sex traffickers, an evangelical militia, and his own demons.

title: The Wicker Man
description: Police sergeant Neil Howie is called to an island village in search of a missing girl whom the locals claim never existed. The investigation is further complicated as Howie’s religious views clash with those of the island’s residents.

title: The Fog
description: In the small coastal California town of Antonio Bay, an old local is spinning tales of a ghostly fog to children on the beach, evoking terrors from 100 years earlier. As the clock strikes midnight, the fog and its vengeful spirits return, once again wreaking havoc. The Fog is seen as a welcome return to the horror genre for Carpenter after the monumental success of Halloween (1978). John Carpenter directs Jamie Lee Curtis, Adrienne Barbeau, and John Houseman through the haunting of Antonio Bay.
director: John Carpenter PRODUCED BY: Debra Hill

title: MY BROTHER'S WEDDING
description: In this tragicomic work of realism, Pierce Mundy (Everett Silas) is employed at his parents’ South Central dry cleaners with no prospects for the future —his childhood buddies are all in prison or dead. Pierce’s best friend Soldier (Ronnie Bell) is just getting out of jail. Pierce’s brother Wendell (Monte Easter), an up-and-coming lawyer, is busy planning a wedding to a snooty upper-middle-class black woman named Sonia (director Charles Burnett’s wife, Gaye Shannon-Burnett, who co-produced the film). Pierce’s pious, Bible-touting mother (Jessie Holmes) provides occasional comic relief but also a heartfelt moral backbone to the film, as she urges Pierce to accept his responsibility to his family.

title: VIKA KIRCHENBAUER PGM 2
description: In the second program of our 2-part retrospective devoted to Vika Kirchenbauer, we dive deeper into the politics of labor in contemporary art, as the artist offers us a WELCOME ADDRESS, directly calling into question the art economy’s coded-progressive positioning of difference and diversity as symbolic cultural currency. Considering the foul, late-stage capitalist “Experience Economy,” YOU ARE BORING troubles the nature of looking. THE CAPACITY FOR ADEQUATE ANGER positions still images from the artist’s presumable childhood archive, gaps of nothingness, and the essay form to offer a critique of the production of contemporary art in the face of upward mobility, mapping subjectivity and political agency. To close this program with a thorough and considered look at the complicit role of artists and art institutions, COMPASSION AND INCONVENIENCE takes us back to 18th century London to trace the first public exhibitions of contemporary art, when materiality intersects with ideology via Liberalism and Enlightenment, taking to task the economic and colonial interests that define/d the “pursuit of refinement.” WELCOME ADDRESS (2017, 9 min, DCP) YOU ARE BORING! (2015, 14 min, DCP) THE CAPACITY FOR ADEQUATE ANGER (2021, 15 min, DCP) COMPASSION AND INCONVENIENCE (2024, 30 min, DCP) Total running time: ca. 75 min. Filmmaker Vika Kirchenbauer in person for both screenings!

title: Bread Day preceded by The Train Stop
description: Every Tuesday, the scant elderly residents of an isolated, nearly abandoned village outside St. Petersburg push an unmanned train car along a spur off the main line that leads into town, supplying themselves and their neighbors with a week’s daily bread—a ritual that, in Dvortsevoy’s hands, appears as both a miracle of tenacity and a pointed commentary on systemic dysfunction. Screens with The Train Stop, Loznitsa’s sumptuously photographed record of sleepers in a station waiting room. “In Loznitsa’s The Train Stop, in the middle of the night, the train doesn’t arrive. The waiting room is full of heavy sleepers, some folded over on their laps, some splayed out over the benches. What could rouse them? Maybe the answer is not a train, but a film. Consider Dvortsevoy’s similarly existential Bread Day. Sure, the rickety cart carrying the week’s delivery of bread to Township 3 of Zhikharevo barely seems to count as a train. It’s manually pushed by the pensioners who will soon argue strenuously with each other as they divvy up its contents. But their shouting is so vigorous, their insults so inventive, that questions of categorization quickly dissipate as the elderly residents, their goats in tow, battle to have the last word.” —Series curator Genevieve Yue The Train Stop (Sergei Loznitsa, 2000, 25 mins) Bread Day (Sergei Dvortsevoy, 1998, 55 mins) Introduction by Genevieve Yue on Saturday, September 5th Part of Trains: Local Routes

title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II – EXILE: Chapters 1-3
description: When Russia shuts down all independent media, a group of young dissident journalists must flee Moscow so they can keep reporting and not go to prison. In her riveting follow-up to last year’s awards-sweeping MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS — LAST AIR IN MOSCOW, Julia Loktev follows these courageous, sharply funny women (and a few men) as they fan out across a dozen countries, to Istanbul, Tbilisi, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam, New York, and beyond. Over the course of four years, they continue to report the truth to Russians from exile, covering their country’s war crimes, even as they face death threats and are declared extremists and terrorists—as they find new meanings of family, friendship, love, and home far from the country to which they may never return. (Viewers can follow EXILE without first seeing LAST AIR IN MOSCOW.)

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: EVERYTHING FOR SALE
description: Wajda’s 8½ is a film-within-a-film about a director’s search for his leading man, who goes missing from the set. It was inspired by the tragic death of Zbigniew Cybulski, the beloved star of ASHES AND DIAMONDS who became an iconic cult figure in Polish cinema. Cybulski died trying to jump off a moving train, a stunt he performed in numerous films. Made in an improvisational, self-referential spirit, the film takes numerous Pirandellian twists, including the performance of Daniel Olbrychski, the actor who became a real-life successor to Cybulski playing the actor who replaces the missing star.

title: Ghostbusters II
description: The discovery of a massive river of ectoplasm and a resurgence of spectral activity allows the staff of Ghostbusters to revive the business.

title: Marketa Lazarová
description: Our screening on Friday 9 October will be introduced by Czech film expert Peter Hames. Voted the best Czech film ever…

title: UNZIPPED
description: “Isaac Mizrahi as he conceived and contorted the way through to his fall 1994 show, [dashing] around a deserted SoHo with pal Sandra Bernhard; [meeting] with Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and baby Kate Moss for fittings; and [racing] uptown to an audience with Eartha Kitt... Hair-raising deadlines, delirious Bette Davis impressions, and the hostile but exhilarating act of executing a designer’s vision come together in a work that set the bar for all fashion films after.” – Vogue

title: The History of Concrete
description: A filmmaker applies lessons from a Hallmark movie writing workshop to pitch a documentary about concrete.

title: The Thing
description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot (Kurt Russell) and the camp doctor (Richard Dysart) lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

title: FILIPIÑANA
description: 17-year-old Isabel navigates the opulent pavilions and lush green landscapes of Dr. Palanca’s luxury golf course as a newly-hired “tee girl.” Meticulously composed, highly stylized, and guided by precisely choreographed movement and deadpan delivery, FILIPIÑANA unfolds through the gradual accumulation of everyday encounters between staff and the wealthy clients of this secluded country club on the outskirts of Manila. When she attempts to return a lost golf club, Isabel uncovers a dark underbelly beneath the club’s pristine surfaces, in this sweltering, pastel-colored fairy tale of class division, institutional patriarchy, and invisible violence.

title: The Uprising
description: Andrew Garfield stars as the legendary leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. As war burns across England, he forms an army of the people to face the King’s might in a fight for justice and survival.

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Sense and Sensibility (U) (AD)
description: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen ’s iconic Sense and Sensibility : a charming, witty and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood, starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles .

title: Nadja
description: In 1993, invited by David Lynch to come up with a low-budget genre movie, Michael Almereyda ( Tesla , Experimenter , Hamlet ) came up with a moody, postmodern reimagining of the Dracula myth which draws inspiration from Dracula’s Daughter (1936) and André Breton’s surrealist novel Nadja . The film follows estranged vampire twins Nadja (Elina Löwensohn) and Edgar (a young Jared Harris) as they reunite following their father’s death by the flamboyantly unhinged Dr. Van Helsing, played with relish by Peter Fonda. The film’s striking visuals combine high-contrast black-and-white 35mm cinematography with the hallucinatory grain of Pixelvision video is now newly restored in 4K.

title: Digger (15) (AD)
description: Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G Iñárritu ( Birdman ) returns with his original feature starring Tom Cruise as the most powerful man in the world.

title: Digger
description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's saviour before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

title: 14th
description: Ava DuVernay follows her epochal 2016 documentary 13th with a thrillingly expansive sequel of sorts, which passionately and persuasively details how the tenets of the 14th Amendment, ratified post–Civil War, are now under systematic attack.

title: The Social Reckoning (15) (AD)
description: In this companion piece to The Social Network , screenwriter Aaron Sorkin returns to the Metaverse with a tale of the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we're seeing play out today.

title: The Fox
description: Tickets Are Only Available via BFI London Film Festival Website from Tuesday 17 September 2026 10:00am: Click Here To Book A talking fox, voiced by Olivia Colman, persuades a hunter to transform his cheating wife into an ideal spouse, in this gleefully outrageous, shape-shifting comedy. As revenge for adultery, who wouldn’t take a talking fox’s advice to throw your cheating partner into a magical outback hole with transformative powers? Dario Russo’s sly, irreverent black comedy mercilessly satirises our baser animal instincts, and is played straight by a terrifically committed cast that includes Jai Courtney and Emily Browning, alongside the vocal talents of Colman and the late, great Sam Neill.

title: Sense And Sensibility
description: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles. Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate following the sudden loss of their wealthy father and are forced to move in with a distant relative. The two sisters attempt to find security and happiness whilst navigating their vastly different approaches to love.

title: MYSTERY EROTIC THRILLER
description:
Mystery Erotic Thriller presents undisclosed deep cuts from the genre’s overheated history - from neon-soaked 80s neo-noir and glossy 90s studio sleaze to forgotten direct-to-video delirium. Expect dangerous affairs, obsessive desire, double-crosses, voyeurism, murder and exquisitely bad decisions, as sex becomes a weapon and nobody proves quite as innocent as they first appear. Come blind, surrender to the mystery and discover a film you may never otherwise have thought to see.
These screenings are strictly for adult audiences and may contain explicit sexual content, violence and other potentially offensive material. Do not attend if you are of a sensitive disposition. Adults only.

title: The Lost Children of Tuam
description: In rural Ireland, amateur historian Catherine Corless begins researching a former institution for unmarried mothers and their children, uncovering a shocking hidden history of loss. Based on the true story, and featuring a powerful performance from Monica Dolan, THE LOST CHILDREN OF TUAM is a deeply moving portrait of one woman’s fight for justice.

title: THE SOCIAL RECKONING
description: A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files. The film is inspired by the true story of how Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the hel...

title: Verity
description: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity’s husband, Jeremy.

title: Gothic
description: Living on an estate on the shores of Lake Geneva, Lord Byron is visited by Percy and Mary Shelley. Together with Byron’s lover Claire Clairmont, and aided by hallucinogenic substances, they devise an evening of ghoulish tales. However, when confronted by horrors, ostensibly of their own creation, it becomes difficult to tell apparition from reality.

title: La Gradiva
description: Director Marine Atlan’s exceptionally accomplished feature debut turns a high school trip to Naples for a group of French teenagers into a revelatory experience, capturing the intimacies of her youthful characters with pinpoint emotional precision.

title: Red Rocks
description: In Bruno Dumont’s drama of danger, purity, and freedom, a group of children between the ages of 5 and 7 enact a kind of pre-preadolescent Romeo and Juliet, complete with rival gangs and puppy love, in a coastal French Riviera town.

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
description: Radu Jude brilliantly explores Europe’s modern-day power and class dynamics through the trenchant story of a young Romanian woman working for a well-to-do family in Bordeaux, while her own young daughter misses her back home.

title: Digger
description: Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu returns with his original film Digger, starring Tom Cruise. The most powerful man in the world (Cruise) embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything. This wildly hilarious satire was shot entirely in VistaVision.

title: The Social Reckoning
description: Explores Facebook's internal practices, spread of false information, impact on teen mental health, and connection to January 6 Capitol events.

title: The Social Reckoning
description: A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files. The film is inspired by the true story of how Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

title: The History of Concrete

title: Resident Evil
description: In this sci-fi horror action reboot, a hapless medical courier fights for his life amid an outbreak of a deadly mutagenic virus in an isolated mountain town.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket
description: In Noah Segan’s elegant love letter to New York, John Turturro delivers a star performance of effortless command and charisma as an aging petty thief from the Bronx who is thrust into a borough-hopping race against time.

title: Fjord
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: A Bittersweet Life
description: A mob enforcer (Lee Byung-hun, No Other Choice) with a sterling record of loyal service finds himself fighting for his life after sparing the life of his boss’s straying mistress (Shin Min-a) in Kim’s drum-tight neo-noir thriller, unusually grounded by both emotional stakes and a sense of real physical danger in the action set pieces, choreographed for the widescreen with much panache. Jang’s second collaboration with Kim, after The Foul King, earned him and collaborator (and Peach Present collective bandmate) Dalparan Best Music honors from the Busan Film Critics Association, responding to the composers’ sophisticated melange of samba, flamenco, solo cello, and electronic elements. Part of Composed by Jang Young Gyu

title: Mermaids
description: It’s 1963, and different-drummer single mother Cher has decided to move from Oklahoma to smalltown Massachusetts, uprooting her two daughters, nine-year-old Kate and Catholicism-obsessed 15-year-old Rachel (Winona Ryder, who provides the narration). What follows includes JFK assassination trauma, a pregnancy scare, mother-daughter sexual competition, and one miraculous rescue, with devastating dynamic duo Cher and Ryder pushing one another to histrionic heights. Part of Winona Ryder Analogue Youth

title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
description: In the questionable town of Deer Meadow, Washington, FBI Agent Desmond inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the more cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.

title: STRAIGHT TO HELL
description: Four hapless bank robbers bury their loot and attempt to hide out in a deserted desert town, but very soon find out that the town is not really deserted. Norwood (Sy Richardson), Simms (Joe Strummer) and Willy (Dick Rude) are three black-suited killers-for-hire. After missing their intended target and trying to escape the wrath of their employer (Jim Jarmusch), they head for the desert and rob a bank en-route. As their car dies in a ravine, the trio bury their money and head for a lonely town to hide out till the heat blows over. The insane cast includes Courtney Love, The Pogues, Grace Jones, Dennis Hopper, Elvis Costello, Kathy Burke and Xander Berkeley.

title: All About Lily Chou-Chou
description: Staff pick by Richard For kids around the world, music is often the only salvation when the pain and anxiety of teenage life becomes too much to bear. Yuichi (Hayato Ichihara) is in the 8th grade and he worships Lily Chou-Chou, a Bjork-like chanteuse whose epic music is lush and transcendent. Yuichi only lives for Lily Chou-Chou’s big Tokyo concert, where the lies and violence can be washed away by the presence of his goddess and her powerful music. But fate has yet another obstacle in store for Lily’s devoted fan.

title: Evil Dead 2
description: After playing a recording of the Book of the Dead found in a seemingly abandoned cabin in the woods and unleashing an evil force that possesses his girlfriend, Ash (Bruce Campbell) is forced into a macabre battle for his life. When four strangers appear in the midst of his mad scramble for survival, more and more possessions and gory deaths pile up.

title: The Exorcist
description: SOMETHING ALMOST BEYOND COMPREHENSION IS HAPPENING TO A GIRL ON THIS STREET, IN THIS HOUSE… AND A MAN HAS BEEN SENT FOR AS A LAST RESORT. When 12-year-old Regan MacNeil falls ill, she becomes violent and puzzles doctors with the personality of a horrifying entity. Desperate for answers, Regan’s movie-star mother Chris seeks the help of two priests: one who has lost his faith, and an exorcist. Winner of 1973 Oscars for Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Sound Mixing, THE EXORCIST remains one of the most shocking and gripping movies in the history of cinema.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description: George Clooney and Quentin Tarantino star as brothers on the lam from the law, hightailing it to Mexico with a kidnapped family in tow. But when they stop at an isolated strip club, they’ll have to try and survive From Dusk Till Dawn while battling the bar’s bloodthirsty denizens in Robert Rodriguez’s pulpy, stylish & hyper-violent cross-genre blast penned by its co-star. Featuring Harvey Keitel, Juliette Lewis & Salma Hayek plus an all-star cast of character actor greats including Cheech Marin, Fred Williamson, Danny Trejo and Tom Savini!

title: The Blair Witch Project
description: Three film students travel to Maryland to make a student film about a local urban legend... The Blair Witch. The three went into the woods on a two day hike to find the Blair Witch, and never came back. One year later, the students film and video were found in the woods. The footage was compiled and made into a movie. The Blair Witch Project.

title: Begotten
description: BEGOTTEN has no characters in the ordinary sense. Its final credits name three principal figures: God Killing Himself. Mother Earth. Son of Earth – Flesh on Bone. The entire film is what those names do to each other and to the earth. God Killing Himself tears open his body and dies. Mother Earth rises from what remains and takes his seed into herself. She gives birth to Son of Earth Flesh on Bone. He is cast into a barren world, seized by the Nomads, tortured, killed, and briefly returned to life by his mother.The Nomads destroy her too. The Robed Figures gather what remains of mother and son, grind their bodies down, and return them to the soil. The ground flowers.

title: The History of Concrete
description: A filmmaker applies lessons from a Hallmark movie writing workshop to pitch a documentary about concrete.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors             / The Blob (1988)
description: Sleep can’t protect the youth of Westin Hills Psychiatric Hospital when a knife-gloved night slasher invades terrified teen dreams and turns their nightmares into deadly reality. But their new therapist has her own tortured history with the dream demon and together they may be able to finally rid the world of Freddy in what may be the ultimate Elm Street sequel.

title: Cartoon Club (Halloween Edition)
description: Our October cartoon spooktacular is a pre-Halloween treat for all the good ghouls & goblins who love everything that goes bump in the night.

title: The Birds
description: A wealthy San Francisco socialite pursues a potential boyfriend to a small Northern California town that slowly takes a turn for the bizarre when birds of all kinds suddenly begin to attack people.

title: Digger
description: Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu returns with his original film Digger, starring Tom Cruise. The most powerful man in the world (Cruise) embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything. This wildly hilarious satire was shot entirely in VistaVision.

title: The Disciple
description: Dutch Moroccan fanboy Tarik Azzougarh spends over a decade working to meet and befriend his heroes, the genre-defining hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan and its iconic spiritual leader, RZA. After joining their movement, he becomes the architect of one of their most talked-about and controversial albums, “Once Upon a Time in Shaolin,” whose radical concept continues to reverberate throughout the music industry. What unfolds is a twisting coming-of-age tale of boyhood dreams, relentless determination and the downfall of flying too close to the sun.

title: The Debut
description: In Jesse Eisenberg’s theater-world comedy, Julianne Moore flings herself with delicious abandon into the role of a middle-aged New Jersey housewife who gets a part in a local stage musical despite having zero experience.

title: Parent & Baby Screening: Digger (15) (AD)
description: Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G Iñárritu ( Birdman ) returns with his original feature starring Tom Cruise as the most powerful man in the world.

title: Extra Geography
description: Set in an English boarding school, Extra Geography follows two teenage girls as they grapple with all the challenges of girlhood: friendship, boys, studies, growing up and their summer project, "to fall in love".

title: The Little Vampire
description: Friendless, plagued by nightmares, Tony Thompson, 8, struggles to adapt to his new home in Scotland and reconcile his obsession with vampires. His nightmares seem to come true when he meets child vampire Rudolph, though the two boys quickly become friends when they realize Tony’s nightmares contain essential information for Rudolph to break a centuries-old curse. Based on Angela Sommer-Bodenburg's children’s book series of the same name, this charming and whimsical tale of finding friendship in unlikely places is populated with eerie cemeteries, beautifully designed aristocratic costumes, and, of course, vampire cows.
director: Uli Edel PRODUCED BY: Richard Claus

title: Inherit
description: Tickets Are Only Available via BFI London Film Festival Website from Tuesday 17 September 2026 10:00am: Click Here To Book A rich Thai family falls apart with the arrival of a distant relative in Banjong Pisanthanakun's (The Medium, LFF 2021) gripping and unpredictable new horror. Grandma Woranart is full of surprises. She claims to be 80, but has the face of a beautiful young woman. That turns out to be the tip of the iceberg, as family secrets are gradually revealed and it becomes all too apparent that something sinister lurks inside this seemingly benign relative. Featuring a magnetic performance by Davika Hoorne (A Useful Ghost), Inherit thrills as much as it chills. Thai Language with English subtitles Content Warning: Contains scenes of graphic violence or injury, self-harm, and sex.

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Fjord (Open Captioning)
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! Please note that there are additional showtimes of FJORD that screen without open captions (on-screen display of dialogue and sounds). For those showtimes, click here. From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: A Man of His Time
description: A mild-mannered bureaucrat (Swann Arlaud) in 1940s Vichy France gradually comes to realize the extent of his government’s collaboration with Nazi Germany in Emmanuel Marre’s quietly sinister portrayal of the incremental evil of fascism, winner of Best Screenplay at Cannes.

title: RoboCop - The Director's Cut
description: I’d buy that for a dollar! For a strange few years, beginning with this runaway hit, the perverse imagination and earthy humor of Verhoeven seemed to sync up perfectly with the desires of the American multiplex-going public. In dystopian Detroit, private sector Omni Consumer Products have taken over policing and made the ultimate law enforcement machine from leftover pieces of peace officer Peter Weller—but they didn’t bank on their invention making his way up the corporate ladder of crime. A frightfully funny vision of a post-industrial cybernetic future, with Kurtwood Smith, Ronny Cox, and Muguel Ferrer an impressive trifecta of irredeemable scumbags. Part of A Cyberpunk Canon

title: Brief Encounter
description: Lean’s simple, tender, and terribly emotionally direct film, featuring never-better Noël Coward dialogue and a Rachmaninoff theme that grows insuperably sad with repetition, follows an affair between a middle-class couple (Celia Johnson and Trevor Howard) who happen to be inconveniently married to other people, their mutual love and mutual agony increasing over the course of seven meetings and departures that begin with a chance in a railway station buffet. One of the great screen romances, full stop. “The trains are mercilessly exact in Brief Encounter—there’s only three minutes between the departures of the trains that take Laura and Alec away from each other, and they’re never late.” —Series curator Genevieve Yue 35mm print provided courtesy of the American Genre Film Archive. Introduction by Genevieve Yue on Saturday, September 5th Part of Trains: Local Routes

title: Heart of the Beast
description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
description: Winner of the Silver Bear for Best Director at the 2026 Berlin Film Festival, Everybody Digs Bill Evans is a biographical drama film about the famous jazz pianist and composer Bill Evans. In 1961, Bill Evans is playing with what he considers the perfect musical trio until tragedy strikes in the premature death of his bass player, Scott LaFaro – his musical soulmate. Traumatised by grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since his childhood. A tug-of-war between personal torment and the seemingly safer haven of familial love will see Evans oscillate between New York and suburbia, his genius always bubbling beneath the surface. The screening on Friday 11th September will be followed by a Q&A with director Grant Gee and actor Valene Kane

title: Paw Patrol 3: The Dino Movie
description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island Sunday 2nd Aug 11am Charity Screening All proceeds from this performance will be donated to MEDICINEMA Cinema-based healthcare programmes inside hospitals

title: Psycho
description: Phoenix secretary Marion Crane (Janet Leigh), on the lam after stealing $40,000 from her employer in order to run away with her boyfriend, Sam Loomis (John Gavin), is overcome by exhaustion during a heavy rainstorm. Traveling on the back roads to avoid the police, she stops for the night at the ramshackle Bates Motel and meets the polite but highly strung proprietor Norman Bates (Anthony Perkins), a young man with an interest in taxidermy and a difficult relationship with his mother.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: A GENERATION
description: Breaking free from the rigid aesthetics of Stalin-mandated socialist realism, Wajda introduced a dynamic, morally complex new approach to filmmaking that reflected the experiences of a young generation shaped by the war. In his bold debut film, the first in his “War Trilogy,” Wajda dramatized the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising with an expressionistic style that evokes American film noir. A delinquent teen who heroically joins the Resistance—partly inspired by his love for one of the movement’s leaders—is the ostensible protagonist, but the more fascinating character is the reluctant and tortured Jasio (Tadeusz Łomnicki). One critic wrote, “It’s a fair guess that the inner world to which Wajda personally felt most attuned was that of Jasio Krone—edgy, troubled, bewildered, switching from one extreme to the other.”

title: Bad Apples
description: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
description: A story set in the ACME warehouse, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
description: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director (Hannah Einbinder, Hacks) for resurrection. But when she visits the original movie’s star (Gillian Anderson, The X-Files, Sex Education), a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

title: UNZIPPED
description: “Isaac Mizrahi as he conceived and contorted the way through to his fall 1994 show, [dashing] around a deserted SoHo with pal Sandra Bernhard; [meeting] with Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and baby Kate Moss for fittings; and [racing] uptown to an audience with Eartha Kitt... Hair-raising deadlines, delirious Bette Davis impressions, and the hostile but exhilarating act of executing a designer’s vision come together in a work that set the bar for all fashion films after.” – Vogue

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

title: Frankenweenie
description: Re-animate your weekend with Tim Burton’s adorably oddball animated send-off to horror, with enough goofs and gaffs for the whole family. Young Victor Frankenstein (Charlie Tahan) is a science nerd and outsider at school, but he does have one good friend: his dog, Sparky. But then, tragedy strikes, and Sparky shuffles off this mortal coil. Victor is heartbroken, but his science teacher (Martin Landau) gives him an idea of how to jolt old Sparky back to life. The experiment is successful, and all goes well, until Victor’s fellow students steal his secret and use it to resurrect other dead animals — with monstrous consequences.

title: Scooby-Doo
description: When the Mystery Inc. gang is invited to Spooky Island, a popular amusement park, they soon discover that the attractions aren’t the only things that are spooky. Strange things are happening, and it’s up to Scooby, Shaggy, Fred, Daphne, and Velma to uncover the truth behind the mysterious happenings.

title: VALENTINA / "Blush"
description: Amidst the humidity of a bustling city-island, a group of teenagers navigates friendship, first love, and the messiness of growing up. “Blush” is an improvisational portrait of youth in Singapore — drawn from the real lives of its cast, and shaped by the moments between.

title: TOP HAT
description: Debonaire hoofer Fred Astaire and the graceful Ginger Rogers star in this Oscar-nominated musical comedy about a woman who mistakenly thinks her best friend’s husband is in love with her. Considered by many to be the dancing duo’s best film, it features a classic Irving Berlin score, including “Cheek to Cheek” and the title song. Look for a young Lucille Ball as a florist shop clerk!

title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II – EXILE: Chapters 1-3
description: When Russia shuts down all independent media, a group of young dissident journalists must flee Moscow so they can keep reporting and not go to prison. In her riveting follow-up to last year’s awards-sweeping MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS — LAST AIR IN MOSCOW, Julia Loktev follows these courageous, sharply funny women (and a few men) as they fan out across a dozen countries, to Istanbul, Tbilisi, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam, New York, and beyond. Over the course of four years, they continue to report the truth to Russians from exile, covering their country’s war crimes, even as they face death threats and are declared extremists and terrorists—as they find new meanings of family, friendship, love, and home far from the country to which they may never return. (Viewers can follow EXILE without first seeing LAST AIR IN MOSCOW.)

title: THE SCOUT
description: Director González-Nasser spent six years working as a location scout. In this luminous directorial debut, she brings us into a day in the life of a young scout tasked with finding the perfect interiors for a television pilot. Sofía (Mimi Davila) moves in and out of other people’s intimate spaces and quotidian lives, tweaking her personality just enough to connect while struggling to find balance between her professional and personal worlds. With a mounting stack of parking tickets and the impertinent commentaries of her crew, she faces a series of small-yet-paralyzing obstacles that render her day increasingly exhausting. Through a constellation of quiet but poignant vignettes, the film offers an original view into the invisible labor of TV production, unfolding as an alternative symphony of a New York grappling with gentrification and a growing erosion of empathy.

title: Gone to Earth
description: Jennifer Jones gives a career-best performance in Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger’s glorious tribute to the otherworldly landscapes where Powell’s father grew up, in the first complete restoration of the original version of Gone to Earth.

title: Comédie Française
description: The Comédie-Française is one of France’s most revered arts institutions, and the oldest still-performing theatre company in the world. There is one golden rule: the play is NEVER cancelled.  Unfortunately for theatre producer Nina (Pauline Clément), everything is unravelling just three hours before the premiere of her first production – an ambitious retelling of Shakespeare’s Macbeth. Her lead actor is stuck on a train, tensions are exploding, passions flaring, equipment breaking down and egos are clashing. With panic setting in and the clock ticking Nina must hold things together at all costs. Will the show go on? France’s hit summer comedy and the runaway winner of four awards at the Alpe d’Huez comedy Film Festival, Comédie Française is a delicious behind-the-scenes farce which is unafraid to poke fun at the highbrow reputation of French theatre. Featuring a cast of real-life members of the Comédie-Française company, this is a gleeful, knowing parody and a sheer delight.

title: The Disciple (Open Captioning)
description: Dutch Moroccan fanboy Tarik Azzougarh spends over a decade working to meet and befriend his heroes, the genre-defining hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan and its iconic spiritual leader, RZA. After joining their movement, he becomes the architect of one of their most talked-about and controversial albums, “Once Upon a Time in Shaolin,” whose radical concept continues to reverberate throughout the music industry. What unfolds is a twisting coming-of-age tale of boyhood dreams, relentless determination and the downfall of flying too close to the sun.

title: Other Mommy
description: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother 35mm
description: Latif is a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith, and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston in search of breast milk for his infant daughter, all while dodging sex traffickers, an evangelical militia, and his own demons.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket
description: In Noah Segan’s elegant love letter to New York, John Turturro delivers a star performance of effortless command and charisma as an aging petty thief from the Bronx who is thrust into a borough-hopping race against time.

title: Whore
description: This searing melodrama investigates the life of a prostitute in a pseudo-documentary style. The life of a hooker isn’t easy…

title: The Social Reckoning (15) (AD)
description: In this companion piece to The Social Network , screenwriter Aaron Sorkin returns to the Metaverse with a tale of the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we're seeing play out today.

title: Trains, Children & Dreams: A Shorts Program
description: A program of short works, including the great-grandaddy of all train-oriented cinema, Louis Lumière’s L’Arrivée d’un train en gare de La Ciotat. “The train that begins Bruce Conner’s Valse Triste also sets in motion a child’s dreaming. Like Conner’s synechdocal found footage classic A Movie, the loosely connected scenes that follow are retrieved from film history, as if to say that our dreams are made of movies, or vice versa. Wasn’t it a kind of dream to imagine, in 1896, that the Lumières’ train would tumble into the audience? Or that, in Ignacio Agüero’s One Hundred Children Waiting for the Train, the children of Lo Hermida, a working class neighborhood on the outskirts of Santiago, might one day see themselves on a real cinema screen? Or, despite the protest made by one of Harun Farocki’s young daughters—‘I don’t want to hear or see any more trains!’—the locomotive that arrives just as she and her sister drift off to sleep?” —Series curator Genevieve Yue One Hundred Children Waiting for a Train (Ignacio Aguero, 1988, 55 mins) L’Arrivée d’un train en gare de La Ciotat (Louis Lumière, 1896, 1 mins) Valse Triste (Bruce Conner, 1977, 5 mins) Bedtime Stories: Railways (Harun Farocki, 1977, 6 mins) Introduction by Genevieve Yue on Saturday, September 5th Part of Trains: Local Routes

title: The Dark Crystal
description: A lavish and stunningly visualized fantasy of mystical adventure and magical imagination! On another world, in another time, a Gelfling embarks on a prophetic quest to restore balance and truth in the universe by finding the missing shard of The Dark Crystal . Jim Henson and Frank Oz use their brilliant puppetry skills to craft a dazzling fairy tale that’s wondrous, poetic, and beautifully haunting – and unlike anything else the big screen has ever seen.

title: Michael Douglas Marathon
description: Michael Douglas and Kathleen Turner star in this high-flying romance about a novelist out to rescue her sister in the jungle and the suave fortune seeker who sidetracks her!

title: An Autumn's Tale
description: Newly arrived in New York City from Hong Kong and unhappily reunited with boyfriend Danny Chan, Jennifer (Cherie Chung) finds a guide to this strange new world in the person of distant relation Samuel Pang, aka “Sampan” (Chow Yun-fat, at his most goofily charming)… and the prospect, possibly, of something more. A time capsule of ’80s NYC—particularly Chinatown—and a perfectly delightful blend of odd-couple romance and amiable comedy from Cheung and longtime collaborator Alex Law, who took home Best Screenplay honors at the 7th Hong Kong Film Awards for his work here. (Lowell Lo’s heartstring-tugging score was, alas, robbed.) Part of The Leaves Are Falling

title: Sense and Sensibility (U) (AD)
description: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen ’s iconic Sense and Sensibility : a charming, witty and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood, starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles .

title: The Social Reckoning
description: A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files. The film is inspired by the true story of how Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

title: Musk
description: Tickets Are Only Available via BFI London Film Festival Website from Tuesday 17 September 2026 10:00am: Click Here To Book In this riveting documentary portrait, Academy Award®-winning filmmaker Alex Gibney brings insight and a fearlessness in peeling away the many layers of Elon Musk’s world. Like his Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room, Oscar-winning Taxi to the Dark Side and Mea Maxima Culpa: Silence in the House of God, Gibney brings a forensic eye to the life and career of the richest – and certainly one of the most divisive – figures in contemporary life. There is also intelligence and no small amount of wit to the way he frames his approach, resulting in a film that’s sure to start conversations.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
description: The new adventure sees the residents of Mossy Bottom Farm looking forward to Halloween - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch. When Shaun turns mad scientist to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control, leading to a wild beast roaming the woods.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: KANAŁ
description: During the celebrated four-minute long shot that introduces us to the beleaguered underground of fighters in Warsaw resisting the Nazi occupation in 1944, the narrator tells us, “These are the heroes of the tragedy. Watch them closely for these are the last hours of our lives.” The centerpiece of Wajda’s “War Trilogy,” and the first Polish film to depict the Warsaw Uprising, KANAŁ follows the fighters through a hopeless but heroic journey that will take them into the city’s sewer system, the only place they can survive. Winner of a Special Jury Prize at Cannes (along with Bergman’s THE SEVENTH SEAL), it became the first of Wajda’s films to open in the U.S. when it premiered at Dan Talbot’s New Yorker Theater in 1961.

title: Off-Circuit: The Seasons
description: Weaving accounts of rural workers and field notes of a couple of archaeologists, amateur footage and scientific drawings, legends, poems and songs, Maureen Fazendeiro's The Seasons is a journey through the real history and the tales of a region in southern Portugal, Alentejo, and a portrait of the people who have lived there.

title: The Uprising
description: Andrew Garfield stars as the legendary leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. As war burns across England, he forms an army of the people to face the King’s might in a fight for justice and survival.

title: Fjord
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: Digger
description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's saviour before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

title: Zëiram
description: Teppei and Kamiya, two average joes working in the electronic services industry, stumble upon the intergalactic bounty-hunter Ilia, and her partner, the artificial intelligence named Bob. Both men are accidentally transported to the Zone, a virtual reality in which Bob has trapped Ilia’s latest prey, a biological weapon named Zeiram. The Earth natives must both survive the experience and help Ilia capture Zeiram before the Zone disappears around them.

title: 30th Anniversary of Get on the Bus
description: In October 1995, group of African American men board a bus for a cross-country trip to Washington D.C. They have different backgrounds and hold varying beliefs, but they’re all on the way to the same march. Among them are a father and a teenage son forced together by court order; a gay couple on the verge of a breakup; an aspiring actor who’s homophobic and loud about it; and a man whose father, a police officer, was killed, he says, “by a brother.” Most of the film takes place in or around the moving bus as the conversations grow more personal, and emotions roil to the surface. Spike Lee’s Get on the Bus , which was shot in three weeks, was financed by a small group of men including Danny Glover, Wesley Snipes, Will Smith, and Johnnie Cochran. Inspired by the Million Man March of 1995, Lee's film delves into the racism that has influenced Black communities for generations, creating space for genuine, and difficult, discourse about the community’s inner and outward-facing conflicts.
director: Spike Lee PRODUCED BY: Reuben Cannon, Barry Rosenbush, Bill Borden

title: Clarissa
description: Oscar nominee Sophie Okonedo stars in twin filmmakers Arie and Chuko Esiri’s tender adaptation of Virginia Woolf’s Mrs. Dalloway, which transports the 1925 novel to contemporary Nigeria while retaining the spiritual essence of Woolf’s themes.

title: LFF: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
Halloween III: Season of the Witch
description: After a terrified toy salesman is mysteriously attacked and brought to the hospital clutching the year's most popular Halloween mask, Dr. Daniel Challis sets out to investigate the strange events and finds himself thrust into a nightmarish conspiracy.

title: Digger
description: Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu returns with his original film Digger, starring Tom Cruise. The most powerful man in the world (Cruise) embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything. This wildly hilarious satire was shot entirely in VistaVision.

title: Sense And Sensibility
description: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles. Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate following the sudden loss of their wealthy father and are forced to move in with a distant relative. The two sisters attempt to find security and happiness whilst navigating their vastly different approaches to love.

title: The Social Reckoning
description: Explores Facebook's internal practices, spread of false information, impact on teen mental health, and connection to January 6 Capitol events.

title: Naza

We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call.
